summary: Launch-readiness regression verified for release-prep scope. Backend accepted custom-scheme checkout origins, auth/profile APIs passed, and mobile web UI auth->home->profile->logout flow worked. One UI issue found on small screens with long usernames hiding the profile icon in home header.

ui_bugs.issue: With long usernames, header text can push the profile icon outside viewport on 375x667, making profile entry via top-right icon untappable.

issues: Header layout does not gracefully constrain long username text on narrow mobile width.

action_items: Constrain or truncate long greeting text in home header so home-profile-button always remains visible/tappable on 375x667.
Optional backend hardening: in validate_origin_url, unreachable raise should be moved out of the return branch to ensure malformed origin URLs return 400 consistently instead of potential 500.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py validate_origin_url has unreachable error handling after return; malformed values may bypass intended 400 handling.
Home header currently lacks robust overflow handling for long usernames on small mobile viewport.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested release-prep checks passed; 1 non-blocking mobile layout issue)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_releaseprep_* and tp* accounts for auth/profile/payment UI regression checks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview was reachable; profile route and logout path were stable in this run. localstripe@example.com is premium so package cards are hidden there; use fresh non-premium accounts to validate package rendering.
rca_of_issue: UI repro: register with long username, land on /home at 375x667, observe greeting text expansion; home-profile-button shifts out of viewport and cannot be tapped. Mitigation: add max width/flex-shrink/ellipsis to greeting container or enforce icon container fixed width.
